card.title: LESSER OF TWO EVILS
card.text: Draw two cards, then choose and discard a card.
card.flavorText: The non-aggression treaty between Germany and Soviet Union, known as the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact, was made on 23 August 1939, but following Operation Barbarossa, the German invasion of Soviet Union, the treaty was declared null and void. The Soviet Union then entered an alliance with the UK and USA in the fight against the Axis powers. This military alliance is called the Grand Alliance, or the Big Three, but some call it the “Strange Alliance” due to the fact that it united the Communist State of Soviet Union with the capitalist state of USA and the colonial power of the UK. Although there were tensions, especially between Soviet Union and the Anglo-American powers, the alliance held throughout the war. After WWII there was much geopolitical tension between the Eastern and Western bloc, and in 1946 the Grand Alliance was terminated and what followed was the Cold War.
